description: Capture exact React element context from a live browser UI and hand it to an AI coding agent as component name, source file path, line number, and HTML. Use when the user wants `react-grab`, element-context copy, component-source lookup from the browser, clipboard-to-agent React debugging, or MCP-backed element selection for React apps. Not for generic browser automation or login/session reuse (`browser-harness`, `playwriter`), broad UI annotation/review (`agentation`), React performance audits (`react-best-practices`), or general design-system work (`design-system`). Triggers on: react-grab, grab element context, copy component to AI, browser component picker, React component inspector, clipboard component source, get element context from browser, grab UI element.
